links.comparator_used: AI diagnosis output for all cases (overall), with no confidence threshold applied
links.outcome: Top-1 diagnosis concordance with the treating clinician's diagnosis
links.effect: 91.3% overall vs 96.3% among cases meeting the pre-specified safety confidence threshold; 97.9% in common, lower-complexity conditions meeting the same threshold
links.quote: The AI’s top-1 diagnosis matched the clinician’s diagnosis in 91.3% of cases overall, increasing to 96.3% among cases meeting a pre-specified safety confidence threshold, and 97.9% in common, lower-complexity conditions that met the same confidence threshold.
